items.title: Meta Rallies Into Connect Conference. Why The Muse AI Agent Is Sending Some Stocks Lower.
items.summary: Meta stock is riding high as the social media giant readies its annual Connect conference, helped by buzz around Muse AI.

items.title: Expedia (EXPE) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of online travel agency Expedia (NASDAQ:EXPE) fell 7.2% in the afternoon session after Barron’s Anita Hamilton wrote that Expedia, Booking Holdings, Tripadvisor, and Airbnb were falling because Muse can book flights and places to stay. Expedia was down 5.5%, to $265.60, by midday Tuesday, she reported. items.summary: Meta’s Muse release has disrupted stocks of online travel booking platforms. Expedia was among those dropping on Wednesday.

items.title: Why Airbnb (ABNB) Shares Are Plunging Today
items.summary: Shares of online accommodations platform Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) fell 6.2% in the afternoon session after Barron’s said Meta’s Muse can make bookings itself, which is the transaction Airbnb charges for when a guest reserves a home.

items.title: Travel Booking Stocks Tumble as Muse Threatens to Bypass Them: Expedia Falls 7%, Airbnb Drops 6%, Booking Holdings Sinks 5%
items.summary: Meta's new AI agent can book a flight or hotel room without ever visiting Expedia, Airbnb, or Booking Holdings, and Wall Street is now asking whether the aggregator business model has a future at all.
